Four repeated amounts never jump to firs.detail: tests/browser/ambiguity.spec.ts test 1 runs a real PDF.js+Tesseract pipeline on a fixture with repeated identical amounts and selects occurrence #3 by its own id-addressed control, asserting the #3 highlight is selected and sibling #1 is not. OccurrenceCandidates resolves candidates strictly by occurrence id; identical-text siblings are labeled 'identical text — k of n at distinct positions'. Ambiguous findings name every evaluated candidate (findings.ts unions entry.candidates' left/right ids) and neither ambiguous nor order-only findings preselect occurrence_ids[0]; a pointer-click leg asserts the pick sticks (review F1 fix).

order-only differences remain order-only.detail: deriveFindings emits result.order_differences as observed_structure findings (basis records emission_order_differs and order distance) gated on groupText equality so differing-text inversions stay reading_difference. Test 3 drives the real reordered-stream fixture through the public workspace and asserts the order_only classification, that no 'readings differ' finding appears, and that no candidate is pre-pressed. A pre-spec real-pipeline probe confirmed the same sealed-report content (commands.log).

incomplete extraction cannot be claimed.detail: Test 4 drives the real tiny fixture: the 1pt text-layer string OCR cannot see produces 'No matching reading found here' classified unmatched with copy 'not proof of missing document text'; the spec asserts forbidden verdict phrasing ('missing from the document', 'Text is missing') never appears anywhere in the viewer. One-sided/incomplete kinds classify honestly — review F3 fixed a page_level mislabel that claimed a comparison never ran.

keyboard selection returns to originatin.detail: Test 5 focuses a candidate inside an expanded ambiguous finding, presses Enter, and asserts focus returns to the originating finding card with aria-pressed intact; Escape returns focus without changing the selection. Arrow keys navigate within the candidate list. Regression: 33/33 across viewer/open/g1/large-mobile after all fixes (commands.log).
